Definition: rescue (literal or figurative, persons, national or spiritual)
BiblicalUsage: The word tᵉshûwʻâh is the Bible's way of saying rescue, deliverance, salvation. In Judges 15:18, Thou hast given this great deliverance into the hand of thy servant. Across its 32 occurrences, the word keeps that same sense, whether the setting is promise or warning.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that salvation is not a word I admire from outside; it is the rescue God has already worked for me. That is why I hold tᵉshûwʻâh fast when easier words tempt me away.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
